optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Service Delivery Manager, Card Dispute Handling

professionalSummary.text: Senior service delivery professional with three years of hands‑on experience running the live card dispute handling service for a major bank, ensuring compliance with scheme deadlines and maintaining high service availability.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the card dispute handling service in production for the bank's cardholder portfolio for three years, holding the production support rota and the deadline escalation procedure for the dispute agents.

professionalSummary.text: Expertise in incident management, having resolved two critical case‑routing outages and documented all actions in the operations incident register.
professionalSummary.witness: Handled the production incidents logged against the service in that period, including the two case‑routing outages of the last year, with incident records filed in the operations incident register.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated monthly production change windows with card operations and technology teams, clearly delineating responsibilities in the change log.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated production changes with card operations and technology in the monthly change window, recording in the change log which checks were mine and which belonged to technology.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained an up‑to‑date runbook and deadline performance report, feeding accurate data into quarterly scheme reports.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the service runbook and the deadline performance report that fed the quarterly scheme reports, updating the runbook after each incident and each change.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored comprehensive post‑incident and hand‑over notes, documenting known limitations and hand‑over conditions for subsequent rota holders.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the post-incident notes and the change hand-over notes, listing the known limitations of the case-routing rules and the conditions handed to the next rota holder.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided tangible evidence of service delivery through a work sample set including the runbook, deadline performance reports for the last two quarters, and incident records for the two case‑routing outages.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the service runbook, the deadline performance report for the last two quarters and the incident records for the two case‑routing outages, with the operations incident register identifiers as a verification trail.

handled the production incidents logged against the service
coordinated production changes with card operations and technology
maintained the service runbook and the deadline performance report

skills.text: Documentation of limitations and hand‑over procedures
skills.witness: wrote the post‑incident notes and the change hand‑over notes

role.roleTitle: Service Delivery Manager, Card Dispute Handling

evidence.text: Ran the card dispute handling service in production for the bank's cardholder portfolio for three years, holding the production support rota and the deadline escalation procedure for the dispute agents.
Handled the production incidents logged against the service in that period, including the two case-routing outages of the last year, with incident records filed in the operations incident register.
holding the production support rota and the deadline escalation procedure for the dispute agents.
Coordinated production changes with card operations and technology in the monthly change window, recording in the change log which checks were mine and which belonged to technology.
Maintained the service runbook and the deadline performance report that fed the quarterly scheme reports, updating the runbook after each incident and each change.
Wrote the post-incident notes and the change hand-over notes, listing the known limitations of the case-routing rules and the conditions handed to the next rota holder.

supportedClaims.claim: Ran the live dispute service for three years, managing production incidents and maintaining runbooks.
supportedClaims.witness: Ran the card dispute handling service in production for the bank's cardholder portfolio for three years, holding the production support rota and the deadline escalation procedure for the dispute agents.

interviewSignalRisks.text: Hiring manager pre-read: the head of card operations wants the packet to show the production incident record with dates and the rota evidence, and to separate production changes from any test-cycle work.
interviewSignalRisks.recommendedHandling: Verify that incident records include dates and that change logs distinguish production from test activities.

followUpQuestions.question: Can you provide the dates and impact details for the two case-routing outages you managed?
followUpQuestions.evidenceTarget: Incident register entries with timestamps and impact assessment.

followUpQuestions.question: How is the production support rota structured and who are the key contacts?

humanReviewChecklist: Confirm that incident records include dates and impact details.
Verify that change logs clearly separate production changes from test-cycle work.
Ensure that runbook updates are documented after each incident/change.
